features: NO DATABASE CHANGES — No migration: succession is a new kind of transfer, and what it needs (the heirs with their shares, the deceased's arrears, the accrual of the usufruct) lives in the transfer's record and in the balance rows that already exist. The full owner, a co-owner or the bare owner dies: the heirs enter in the same role, each with their share, from the day of death, and the deceased remains holder until the day before.

CHANGED: THE TERMINATION OF A USUFRUCT WITH NO BARE OWNER CURRENTLY RUNNING IS REFUSED BY THE SERVER TOO — Up to .43 only the form stopped it, looking at today's holders instead of those of the day of the deed; the server recorded it, and the unit was left without an owner. The message says to associate the bare owner first or, if the bare ownership is recorded as full ownership next to the usufruct, to correct the role of that row.

CHANGED: A TRANSFER RECORDED OUT OF ORDER NO LONGER REOPENS A ROW THAT A LATER TRANSFER HAS ALREADY CLOSED — Example: Elsa and Franco at 50 %; first Franco's sale to Elsa of 1 September is recorded, then Elsa's sale with reserved usufruct to Dino of 1 May, from Elsa's earlier row. Up to .43 the recording closed that row again on 30 April, and from 1 September the unit showed Elsa full owner at 100 %, Elsa usufructuary at 50 % and Dino bare owner at 50 %, and neither transfer could be cancelled any more. Now the preview stops and gives the way: cancel the later transfers, the last one first, record this one and then those again; if the later transfer ceded that very row, the correction by hand. It applies to the person leaving, to whoever buys or inherits a share that adds to their own, to whoever reserves the usufruct, to whoever creates one, to the bare owner who becomes full owner again and to the accrual.

CHANGED: WHOEVER ENTERS A TRANSFER MUST BE A PERSON OF THE BUILDING — And so must every heir. Before, the server only checked that the person record existed: a transfer could open a row for a person of another building, whom the form does not offer.

CHANGED: IN THE ACCOUNT STATEMENT THE CREDIT OF A TRANSFER STILL IN THE BALANCES IS COUNTED NET, BY MANAGEMENT AND UNIT — With several settlement pairs on the same unit a person may have one in credit and one in debit: since .41 only the credit one was counted, and the announced credit was inflated (€ 322.19 instead of € 5.48 in the tested case).

CHANGED: WITHOUT ALLOCATION ROWS, THE PART THAT REACHED THE SELLER IS FOLLOWED ALONG THE CHAIN — On plans generated before 1.11.0-beta.29, up to .43 it was counted only on the direct transfer: after a full sale followed by a transfer of one half, the first holder's shares entered in full into the seller's settlement. Now a full transfer carries the part of the transfer after it, and a succession after a half transfer multiplies the parts (grandparent, children, grandchildren: half of a half). Two partial terminations in a row are still counted on the direct transfer.

CHANGED: «DELETE PERSON» ALSO STOPS FOR WHOEVER HAS BALANCE ROWS OF A TRANSFER OR ROWS WRITTEN BY A TRANSFER — For example the second bare owner who became full owner again, whom the transfer does not name as the incoming person: the cascading deletion removed one leg of the settlement pair, or a row that the transfer could no longer undo.
CHANGED: THE MESSAGE AFTER RECORDING SAYS «RESULTS», IN THE PRESENT, FOR ALL KINDS — Before it said «was holder», a gendered form in Italian, and the plural stayed in the future.

CHANGED: THE TRANSFER HISTORY SHOWS THE SETTLEMENT OF EACH PERSON WHO ENTERS — At a termination with several bare owners it showed only the first one's. With several people entering it gives each one's row and, separately, the row of the person leaving.

SUCCESSION: THE FORM — «Record transfer» has a fifth entry, «Succession», also in the row menu («Record the succession»). The deceased is chosen among the current holders; the heirs, each with the share they inherit, together make up the deceased's share («Split in equal parts» divides it to the hundredth of a point; a share has at most two decimals and at least 0.01 %). An heir who is already a co-owner adds the inherited share to their own; a minor heir is recorded like the others. The linked appurtenances follow the unit, and the deceased's share of the garage is split among the heirs in proportion. The death of the usufructuary remains the termination of the usufruct.

THE SETTLEMENT — It is the sale's one, by days: the part from the day of death is split among the heirs by share. The draft instalments of a plan that can no longer be recalculated pass to a single heir, the reference heir, whom the program asks for only when they are needed; that heir's part of the settlement goes down by as much, and may become a credit. The other heirs have no instalments on that plan: their part sits in balance rows and enters the next plan.

THE DECEASED'S ARREARS — The instalments issued and not paid, the deceased's drafts and balances, that is the deceased's position towards the building. The choice is the administrator's, with no answer given in advance. To the heirs, by share: balance rows on the same management, one in credit for the deceased and one in debit for each heir; with the settlement each heir answers for their share of everything and the deceased's position closes; the drafts from before the death also pass to the reference heir, except those with a payment. Or in the deceased's name («heirs of …»): it stays where it is, and whoever pays in the deceased's place is recorded with «Paid by». Example, on € 1,200.00 a year in twelve instalments: Ugo dies on 1 May with four instalments issued and unpaid and eight in draft; heirs Anna at 60 %, reference heir, and Bruno at 40 %. The eight drafts pass to Anna; the settlement is a credit of € 316.71 for Anna and a debit of € 322.19 for Bruno; the arrears are € 236.71 for Anna and € 157.81 for Bruno. In the end Anna answers for € 720.00 and Bruno for € 480.00, 60 % and 40 % of the year, and Ugo's position is zero. If the deceased had paid more, the arrears are a credit and pass to the heirs in the same way. With the arrears to the heirs the settlement alone cannot be cancelled or waived: settlement and arrears are one account. For the deceased's contributions up to the day before the death the heirs answer, each for their share (art. 754 of the Italian Civil Code), with both choices: what changes is only where the debt is written. The panel warns that, with the arrears to the heirs, the deceased's unpaid instalments stay in the deceased's name and are not to be collected (a payment, even with «Paid by», would leave the deceased in credit), and that with a single heir on the unit the arrears go entirely to that heir, even when the estate has other heirs.
THE LEGACY — Whoever receives the unit by legacy does not inherit the estate: the deceased's arrears stay in the deceased's name, necessarily. There may be more than one legatee.

THE ACCRUAL — At the termination of a usufruct, with another usufructuary currently running, the box «The usufruct accrues to the other usufructuary», to tick when the deed provides for it or for the joint legacy of usufruct (articles 675 and 678 of the Italian Civil Code): the usufruct of the person who dies goes to the remaining usufructuaries, in proportion to their share; the bare ownership stays bare, and the settlement of the ordinary expenses goes to them. Without the box the rule of law remains: the bare ownership merges with the usufruct that ends. With the bare ownership held by several bare owners the accrual is not recorded from here, because the program does not know which usufruct sits on which bare ownership: the box is not there, and the form says to correct the rows by hand. At the next termination the choice on ordinary expenses of the remaining person's own usufruct applies, and the panel says if the part that arrived was born with the opposite choice.

THE DEATH OF THE BARE OWNER — The bare ownership passes to the heirs by share, and at the termination of the usufruct they become full owners again, without the administrator having to choose. If an heir already holds the usufruct of the unit, the transfer stops and shows the way by hand.

PLANS THAT CAN STILL BE RECALCULATED — The succession does not take them: the recalculation follows them, giving the heirs the days from the death split by share and leaving the deceased the days before. The panel says so: with the arrears to the heirs it points to the manual balance to pass those days to the heirs too; with the arrears in the deceased's name it warns that those shares stay in the deceased's name, with a part in every instalment of the plan.

WHEN AN HEIR SELLS — The settlement also includes the instalments passed to the reference heir, with the seller's share; the instalments stay with the reference heir. The buyer pays their days on the whole plan.

WHERE YOU SEE IT — The «What will change» panel: the heirs, the settlement per heir, the arrears table, «Who remains liable» with art. 754 of the Italian Civil Code for the contributions up to the death and the heirs as co-owners afterwards. The message after recording, with the net per heir and an account statement for each. The unit's history: the heirs with their shares, the arrears per heir, the settlement. The Wallet: the arrears rows and the balances the arrears are calculated from cannot be changed or deleted on their own, and say why; they are corrected by cancelling the succession and recording it again. The deceased's account statement does not offer to refund what passed to the heirs. Cancelling the succession puts everything back as it was.
FIXED: THE SPACE BEFORE «%» — In the sentences of the panel and of the messages the space before «%» no longer breaks the line.
FIXED: THE END OF A LEASE AND THE SUBTYPE — The server accepted a subtype in the end of a lease («creation») and wrote it in the transfer's record.

FIXED: THE WAIVER NOTE OUTSIDE A SALE — In the usufruct and the lease the note under the waiver of the settlement said «it applies between seller and buyer», with a ruling on sales: now it says «it applies between the parties».

THE GUIDES — The property transfer guide has the section «When an owner dies» (the heirs and the shares, the settlement, the reference heir, the arrears to the heirs or in the deceased's name, the legacy, the death of the bare owner) and the point on the accrual in «When a usufruct ends».

NOT YET — The sale of part of one's own share is not there: when a later transfer ceded a row that then adds up, the way is by hand. Drafts already created are not split by share among the heirs, one for each: they go to the reference heir, and the other heirs pay their part with the balance rows, in the next plan. The deceased's credit in the balances, absorbed by a later plan, sits next to the deceased's unpaid instalments and must be offset by hand. With three or more usufructuaries after an accrual, at the termination the program asks which bare owners become full owners again (the right answer is «all, each for their share»). Without allocation rows two partial terminations in a row are counted on the direct transfer. Arrears that find no open financial year to be written on stay in the deceased's name: the message, the history and «Who remains liable» say so. The share-by-share calculation of a bare ownership of two pieces that became full again only in part, which stops, comes later.

FOR DEVELOPERS — No migration: subentri.tipo_passaggio also takes successione (string), with the subtype legato. In the transfer's registro: eredi [{anagrafica_id, quota, riga_id}], arretrato {scelta, totale, resta, saldi, fonti, non_scritto}, accrescimento [{anagrafica_id, quota, riga_id}].
